Let me look at the relevant frontend code to understand the question rendering.  

I need to look at how the questions tab interacts with the analysis display to identify the double-render source.  

Let me search for where "Options:" text format is generated:  

Let me look at the backend question generation to see if "Options:" is embedded in question text:  

Found the source. Let me look at that context in `conversation_manager.py`: 

Let me look at the question generation prompt and data structure:   

Let me look at how the analysis response is processed in the frontend and what triggers `askPostAnalysisQuestions`: 

Let me look at `extractStructuredQuestionsFromAssistantText` - this is likely parsing the plain text "Options:" format: 

Found it. In `analyzeJob()`, `extractStructuredQuestionsFromAssistantText(analysisText)` parses the backend's chat text (which includes `"Options: A / B / C"` embedded in question blocks). These get merged with the properly structured questions from `context_data.post_analysis_questions`, but de-duplication fails because the question text strings differ — the text-extracted version includes the "Options:" line. Both end up in `window.postAnalysisQuestions`, causing each question to render twice: once with chips from the structured data, once as plain text from the extracted version.

The fix: don't call `extractStructuredQuestionsFromAssistantText` when structured questions are already present. 

Now rebuild the bundle:
